visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with long brown hair and a white and yellow traditional floral qipao stands centered in a brightly lit room. She holds her hands together in a traditional greeting gesture, looking directly at the camera with a wide smile and expressive eyes. The background consists of a traditional Chinese wooden screen, adorned with red lanterns and paper-cut decorations. (2) As she speaks, the woman occasionally shifts her hand placement, while gold ingot graphics and red framed overlays remain at the top and bottom of the frame. The lighting is warm and even, highlighting her facial features and the intricate floral patterns on her dress. (3) The scene cuts to a vibrant red graphic background where a small cartoon snake wearing a red vest holds a traditional lantern. Gold clouds and traditional patterns surround the central text, while a website URL is displayed clearly at the bottom.
